name: Kep

deep.seasons: Dry Nov-Apr is best. May-Oct monsoon is quiet and green; sea can be choppy.
deep.airports: None — 3h road transfer from Phnom Penh (PNH) or 40min from Kampot
deep.notes: Former French resort town gone beautifully sleepy. The crab market (fresh pepper crab) is the ritual. Kep Beach is small; Rabbit Island 20min by boat has the better sand.

docs.entry: Cambodia e-visa (~$36) or visa on arrival ($30) for most nationalities; 30 days.
docs.insurance: Basic cover fine; nearest serious hospital is Phnom Penh.
special: US dollars are the everyday currency — small change comes in Cambodian riel
docs.health: None required; dengue exists, use repellent at dusk.
docs.agency: No agency needed — e-visa at evisa.gov.kh is official.

bestMonths: Best Nov, Dec, Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr for dry days and calm sea. May-Oct is monsoon; quiet and green but choppy.
crowd: Sleepy even in high season; weekend day-trippers from Phnom Penh, empty by Monday.
